description: Oklahoma Secretary of State business entity bulk orders (paid). Gated on purchase and robots.txt. See docs/registry/sources/ok-sos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Oklahoma Secretary of State, Business Filing Department
sources.gate: Purchase, and robots.txt blocks automation. 'Bulk Order Fee Schedule': Master Download $500.00, Weekly Filing Update $150.00, custom lists $1 per 40 records, ordered through the Secretary of State's shopping cart (login required). https://www.sos.ok.gov/robots.txt is 'User-agent: *' 'Disallow: /', so the collector may not fetch any page or file there. Requires a person: place the $500 Master Download order, download it by hand, read the order terms, and place it in collected/ok-sos-entities/.
sources.license: Not read beyond the order page (no licence text on it); the order terms are shown in the cart. Public records under the Oklahoma Open Records Act (51 O.S. 24A.1 et seq.)
sources.notes: The page describes the monthly export as 'our complete database in a tilde(~)-delimited text file' with 19 relational tables, about 600 MB unzipped; weekly updates have the same structure. A layout file and a sample weekly file are linked from the page; they were not fetched because of robots.txt. The order page was opened once, by hand, before robots.txt was read; nothing else on the host was fetched. Natural-person names (agents, officers) must not be stored.
